# は — topic, contrast, scope

**[は (topic)](<../grammar/wa.md#topic> "Marks the sentence topic.")**
:   Plain topic — marks what the sentence is about, then comments on it: 私は学生です。Known, shared information with no contrast intended.

**[は (contrast)](<../grammar/wa.md#contrast> "As for this item specifically, contrasts it with another possibility")**
:   Sets one item against another, stated or implied: 犬は好きですが、猫はちょっと…。Spoken with stress; a second は in the sentence is a strong hint.

**[は (scope)](<../grammar/wa.md#scope> "Marks the scope to which a statement or prohibition applies.")**
:   Limits how far a statement or rule applies, riding on another particle: ここでは吸えません — no smoking HERE, elsewhere maybe. Look for では・までは・からは.
